# HugeHard Studio

> “这图能改” (English site name: “This Pic Can Change”) is an iPhone photo and video utility for iOS 17 and later. Images can be converted among HEIC, JPEG, PNG, and GIF, cropped, rotated, resized, or compressed. Video clips can be turned into GIFs or Live Photos; video compression is also available. The app interface is Simplified Chinese, and iPad runs the iPhone compatibility layout. Version 1.2 (5) and its one-time non-consumable lifetime unlock have been submitted for App Review and are waiting; neither is on the App Store.

The version 1.2 (5) test build includes six on-device media tools: video to Live Photo, video compression, video to GIF, image compression, format conversion, and resizing. It also includes Screenshot Delivery, photo widgets, four games, and optional AI image generation and editing configured by the user. Ordinary image and video processing runs on device. Optional AI requests go to the configured provider, which may process submitted content and charge the user. The legacy public TestFlight page may still refer to version 1.0 (2); it is not a download link for version 1.2 (5): [legacy TestFlight page](https://testflight.apple.com/join/GK8ht2vv). Support: hugehardzhang@gmail.com.
